paragraphs.source_en: No sooner was the grave finished than the monk had novices bring a Buddhist shrine and buckets of ceremonial flowers. Lady Tsukiyama, Ieyasu's lawful wife, had been swept into a whirlpool of tragedy and taken her own life to save her son Nobuyasu. She was therefore given the posthumous Buddhist name Saikōin-den Seigan Shūtei Koji.

paragraphs.source_en: “My lady, go without fear. Please go in peace to the Pure Land.” Shigemasa repeated the words several times in his heart, then arranged flowers around the grave and burned incense.

paragraphs.source_en: The two men who had treated the lady with such cold hostility now let their shoulders droop in silence, scarcely daring to breathe. They offered only this warning: “You must say... that my lady took her own life of her own accord.”

units.source_en: The two men who had treated the lady with such cold hostility now let their shoulders droop in silence, scarcely daring to breathe. They offered only this warning: “You must say... that my lady took her own life of her own accord.”
units.source_zh: 一直对夫人横眉冷对的二人，也默默地垂着肩膀，大气也不敢出，只是嘱咐了这么一句：“你一定得说……是夫人主动自尽的。”

paragraphs.source_en: Shigemasa bit hard into his lip, raised his head, and addressed Ieyasu, who lay upon his bed: “When we reached the valley before Kita-Tomitsuka, my lady drew her blade and cut her own throat in the hope of pleading for the young lord's life.”

units.source_en: Shigemasa bit hard into his lip, raised his head, and addressed Ieyasu, who lay upon his bed: “When we reached the valley before Kita-Tomitsuka, my lady drew her blade and cut her own throat in the hope of pleading for the young lord's life.”
units.source_zh: 重政狠狠地咬了咬嘴唇，抬起头来，看着躺在床上的家康说道：“在走到北富冢前面的山谷时，夫人为了给少主乞命，拔刀自刎了。”

paragraphs.source_en: When Ieyasu uttered the words, “So you made her kill herself,” Shigemasa gave a sudden start and hastily prostrated himself. He thought Ieyasu had already divined that they had slain the lady. Terror shook his entire body, and he could no longer even make out Ieyasu's face.

paragraphs.source_zh: 当家康说到“使她自杀了吧”一句时，重政突然一怔，慌忙伏在了地上。他以为家康已经敏锐地察觉到是他们斩杀了夫人，吓得浑身发抖，连家康的脸都看不清了。
